mapper.sql: m.mail_status = 1 AND ( (m.sender_id = #{userId} AND m.sender_deleted = FALSE) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mail_receiver mr WHERE mr.mail_id = m.mail_id AND mr.receiver_id = #{userId} AND mr.is_deleted = FALSE ) )
mapper.select: SELECT m.mail_id, m.sender_id, m.subject, m.content, m.send_time, m.has_attachment, m.is_spam, m.priority, m.mail_status, m.sender_deleted FROM mail m WHERE AND ( #{keyword} = '' OR m.subject LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY m.send_time DESC
